findings.summary: Production standalone startup bypasses the local-auth environment rejection and can enable unrestricted administration.
A remote client can forge a loopback X-Forwarded-For header and receive the unrestricted local administrator session.
Ordinary plan accounts can create, edit and delete the shared product/decorations catalogue because write handlers reuse read/tool permissions.
Entusiasta and Designer can invoke assembly-plan, drawing and plan-edit APIs reserved to Master Designer and staff.
The cost calculator API requires account administration, denying Designer Plus, Master Designer and internal staff their contracted tool.
A sign-in using the old password can insert an unrevoked session after a concurrent password reset has committed.
The lockout can expire shortly after the fifth failure instead of refusing the email for a full fifteen minutes.
Login and logout accept cross-origin form POSTs, allowing login CSRF and forced browser sign-out.
The login destination check accepts a slash-backslash URL that redirects successful sign-in to an attacker origin.
Local mode returns a synthetic non-UUID account without persisting the local administrator required by account-management operations.
Retained cookie-shape authentication rejects cookie-free local-administrator requests after the new permission guard allows them.
Password creation/reset has no 200-character maximum and can save passwords that the login transport refuses.
The first-administrator command rejects the approved --correo argument syntax before attempting provisioning.
The test-account seeder creates test+role@req021.test addresses instead of the agreed plan@prueba.local fixtures.
The integration matrix derives its oracle from the implementation map, sends only GET, and counts 405 and server errors as allowed API access.

findings.evidence: att-0013: actual createAccountService with a controlled two-client SQL double reproduced login-read-old-hash -> reset-password -> reset-revoke -> reset-commit -> login-insert-session; resulting session unrevoked, stdin Node probe exit 0. signIn and resetPassword still have no shared credential lock/version. npm run cuentas:test-servicio could not initialize without a dedicated test database; real PostgreSQL concurrency not executed. Remains open for T1.3.
findings.summary: A sign-in using the old password can insert an unrevoked session after a concurrent password reset has committed.

findings.evidence: att-0013: actual signIn with SQL-double failure times 0,1,2,3,14 minutes issued a session at minute 15.1; actual query cutoff leaves count=1 although lockout should last through minute 29. Stdin Node probe exit 0. No durable lockout deadline exists in servicio.ts/037_cuentas.sql. Remains open for T1.3.
findings.summary: The lockout can expire shortly after the fifth failure instead of refusing the email for a full fifteen minutes.

findings.evidence: att-0013: actual login POST with foreign Origin and URL-encoded synthetic credentials returned 303 and a session cookie using a pg connection double; actual cookie-free foreign-origin logout returned 200 and Max-Age=0. Stdin Node probe exit 0, no real DB/browser. Neither handler calls same-origin/CSRF validation. Remains open for T1.4.
findings.summary: Login and logout accept cross-origin form POSTs, allowing login CSRF and forced browser sign-out.

findings.evidence: att-0013: actual login POST with from='/\attacker.example/path' returned 303 Location=https://attacker.example/path using synthetic credentials and a pg connection double. Stdin Node probe exit 0; safeDestination still checks only leading slash and rejects only double forward slash. No cookie disclosure is claimed. Remains open for T1.4.
findings.summary: The login destination check accepts a slash-backslash URL that redirects successful sign-in to an attacker origin.

findings.evidence: att-0013: actual resolveRequestSession on a cookie-free localhost request returned accountId=administrador-local; stdin Node probe exit 0. modo-local.ts has only a constant identity, no provisioning; accounts.id is UUID and service requireAdministrator queries a persisted active administrator. No actual DB operation attempted. Remains open for T1.5.
findings.summary: Local mode returns a synthetic non-UUID account without persisting the local administrator required by account-management operations.

findings.evidence: att-0013: actual local resolveRequestSession succeeded and requireApiPermission(request, chat_asistido) returned null, then actual atenderLecturaMotor returned 401 before its injected reader ran. Stdin Node probe exit 0. Legacy cookie-shape checks also remain in ia/proveedor and other handlers. Remains open for T1.6.
findings.summary: Retained cookie-shape authentication rejects cookie-free local-administrator requests after the new permission guard allows them.

findings.evidence: att-0013: actual activate with a SQL double wrote a hash for a 1025-character password, while actual login POST rejected that password with 401 before service access; stdin Node probe exit 0. Shared passwordIsValid still only checks length >=8. Remains open for T1.3.
findings.summary: Password creation/reset has no 200-character maximum and can save passwords that the login transport refuses.

findings.evidence: att-0013: npm run cuentas:primer-admin -- --correo audit@example.test exited 1 with Uso: npm run cuentas:primer-admin -- correo@ejemplo.com. Parser rejects two arguments before creating a pool, so no account/link was created. Remains open for T1.3.
findings.summary: The first-administrator command rejects the approved --correo argument syntax before attempting provisioning.
